All operations are transparent and aligned with standard AUR packaging practices for DKMS modules.

The maintainer-provided source URL and checksum match the release tag, and no dynamic or mutable sources (like git branches with forced updates) are used. The package does not install systemd services, hook scripts, or perform any post-install actions outside of what DKMS handles automatically. Everything is consistent with a minimal, secure DKMS package.
